idea: Keep a table of distances between every pair of nodes. Allow the nodes one at a time as a stop on the way, and replace a distance whenever going through that node is shorter. A negative number on the diagonal means a negative cycle.
useWhen: You need the shortest distance between every pair of nodes
The graph is small or dense
Negative edges are allowed but there are no negative cycles
avoidWhen: The graph is large: the table and the cubic time grow fast
You only need distances from one start node (use Dijkstra or Bellman-Ford)
